description: Fixed visual audit for first-room production dwarf-miner animation Frames.
occlusion_rule: An identity anchor may disappear only when the pose clearly occludes it; do not add a feature through an arm, hand, tool, or turned-away surface.

fixed_questions.question: Are short/broad proportions, beard mass, the oversized blue lamp helmet, green clothing, belt and buckle, gloves, boots, and pickaxe legible and temporally consistent whenever the pose exposes them?
Does the machine-readable check report show automatic Identity Lock PASS for every Frame before you judge exposed identity outside the locked regions?
When the eye is exposed, is it a single black Cell with no white sclera?
At native scale, are face/beard, beard/torso, hands/handle, legs/torso, and boots/ground separated rather than accidentally melding at same-value contacts?
Do Master Palette roles, upper-left local light, and selective warm-dark outline remain stable across Frames?
Do identity accents and intentional outlines remain stable across Frames without one-Frame decorative flicker?

walk.question: Do the alternating legs remain separable from each other and from the torso throughout the loop?
Does the torso keep a stable silhouette and readable upper-body mass throughout the loop?

swing.question: Does the swing sequence show readable anticipation before the strike?
Does the pickaxe preserve a clear, continuous action arc across the one-shot sequence?
Is the gripping hand distinguishable from the pickaxe handle at native scale?
Do the boots read as planted and stable through the swing?
At Frame 3, is mining contact readable without losing hand, tool, or boot separation?

editing_rules: Use the fewest changed Cells that resolves the observed defect.
Use only colors already allowed by the combined Draft palette.
Never change alpha, baseline, dimensions, Frame order, or silhouette.
Prefer restoring an identity anchor or separating forms over adding decorative detail.
Never override an automatic Identity Lock FAIL with a visual PASS.
Return UNCERTAIN instead of inventing intent when the profile and pose do not settle the edit.
audit_workflow: Read the machine-readable check report before opening art; confirm automatic Identity Lock PASS when walk or swing applies.
For walk and swing, generate sequential image-edit Attempts from the deterministic identity seed until provenance, Identity Lock, coherence, and polish pass.
Inspect one composite or animation preview at native scale and enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling.
Answer every fixed question and every applicable Motion-class override.
Apply the fewest permitted Cell edits for EDIT verdicts.
Re-render the preview and run strip:polish check.
Report every UNCERTAIN verdict and do not finalize until it is resolved.
